title: Nearchus
subtitle: Admiral of Alexander's Fleet
bodyText: Nearchus commanded Alexander's fleet from the Indus towards the Persian Gulf. His account of the difficult coastal voyage, preserved through later writers, joined practical seamanship to an enduring record of unfamiliar shores.

sources.title: Arrian, Indica — Fordham University Ancient History Sourcebook
Arrian on Nearchus' voyage home — Livius
